mapper.select:
SELECT m.*,
(6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{latitude})) * cos(radians(m.latitude)) * cos(radians(m.longitude) - radians(#{longitude})) + sin(radians(#{latitude})) * sin(radians(m.latitude)) )) AS distanceKm
NULL AS distanceKm
FROM merchant m
m.status = 1
AND m.category = #{category}
AND (m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND m.rating >= #{minRating}
AND m.avg_price <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY
distanceKm ASC
m.rating DESC
LIMIT
#{limit} 20
